thread:
dino: Kicking off tonight's staggered deploy (00:30-02:30 UTC). Targeting v2.4.1 for API/runtime/console/router. Plan: pin router->v2.4.1, runtime->v2.4.1-quant, console->v2.4.1-ui, api->v2.4.1. Canary slices: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%. Need quick acks and any hard blockers.

cara: ack for console. release notes are up: https://go/release/RI-1234 :tada:

ben: runtime ack. note that the new quant kernels need a kernel toggle in infra-config (batching.kernels=v2). I'll patch infra before canary.

alice: API ack. I'd prefer 5% initial canary for API (users are sensitive). 1% for router/runtime ok.

jun: ops here. SLO/alerts: set error-rate >0.5% sustained 5m OR 95th latency +50ms sustained 5m -> auto-rollback. Also add a manual hold flag if console visual regressions show up. I'll watch.

deploy-bot: deploybot: scheduled canary job created by dino. Executing phase 1: router -> v2.4.1 (1% traffic) on eu-west-1.

ops-bot: metric-hook: router eu-west-1 1% slice steady. 95th latency +3ms, errors 0.02%.

ben: infra config patch applied: batching.kernels=v2 deployed to runtime infra, rolling restart queued.

dino: good. Proceeding to runtime 1% canary next after router stable for 10m.

deploy-bot: deploybot: runtime -> v2.4.1-quant canary at 1% (eu-west-1).

ops-bot: runtime canary metrics: CPU +12%, p99 +8ms, errors 0.15% (below threshold). No new OOMs.

cara: console canary ready but we have a small CSS regression on /projects list in staging. Not sure it hits production.

dino: hold console at staging patch until we see runtime/router at 5%. Do not promote console to 20% until UI regression triaged.

alice: promoting API to 5% now (per my ask). deploy-bot please proceed.

deploy-bot: deploybot: api -> v2.4.1 canary 5% (global slice).

ops-bot: alert-check: api errors jump to 0.6% in the 5% slice (sustained ~3m). Latency flat.

alice: seeing the same in logs: a new request handler in v2.4.1 returns 500 on edge-case for malformed header. Quick patch is possible but invasive.

jun: per rollback criteria (error-rate >0.5% sustained 5m) we should roll back API slice. Waiting 2m to confirm trend.

dino: rolling back API canary to v2.4.0 for safety, hold other promotions. Marking in release notes.

deploy-bot: deploybot: api rollback initiated -> pinned to v2.4.0. Canary terminated.

ops-bot: api 5% slice rollback complete. error-rate back to baseline.

cara: console regression still only in staging. I'm going to run a quick visual smoke in prod 1% slice if you want.

dino: yes run smoke on prod 1% but do not increase traffic. If UI glitch appears, we'll pin console back to v2.4.0-ui.

cara: ran smoke on 1% -> no visible regression on sampled pages. thumbs up.

ben: runtime/router look healthy. I'd be comfortable promoting router/runtime to 5% and then 20% if no regressions.

dino: agreed. Reopen promotions: router/runtime -> 5% now, console held at 1% (staging patch queued), API pinned.

deploy-bot: deploybot: router -> 5% promoted. runtime -> 5% promoted.

ops-bot: runtime p99 increased +12ms at 5% for a burst but stabilized in 4m. errors still <0.2%.

jun: manual check: session-store latency ok. No KV pressure. Recommend ramp to 20% after 15m stable.

dino: ramping router/runtime to 20% in 15m if stable. API stays pinned until patch merged. Console stays at 1% until staging fix.

alice: noted. I'll open a patch PR for the API header edge-case and link it in the release notes.

cara: console PR created for CSS fix, will request quick review from ux. Tagging @dino when ready.

deploy-bot: deploybot: scheduled router/runtime ramp to 20% at 1750001312 UTC if no holds.

dino: thanks all. If anyone sees >0.5% error for any service during the ramp, call it out and we'll trigger rollback. :hand:

jun: watching. ping me if you need the emergency pinback.
